summary: TORUS gateway API + web UI + bash installer deeply tested. Backend: 26/26 pytest assertions pass (security headers, Host guard, validation, wiki->done/local, example.com fresh->needs_you, paste(>=50 chars)->done, short paste 400, skip_all, cancel, settings persistence to /tmp/torus-test/etc/{llm.toggle,search.conf}, llm_enabled-without-key still completes with local fallback, brave mode without key does not crash, /api/search, /api/jobs, /api/status, dossiers populated). Web UI at 127.0.0.1:7777 (390x844 viewport, vanilla JS hash routes): ask form submits -> navigates to #/job/<id>, status reaches 'done' with engine='local', job-answer rendered. Needs-you flow verified end-to-end: fresh https://example.com/ job -> needs_you card -> paste 989-char HTML -> status 'done' -> answer with answer-path '/tmp/torus-test/vault/answers/<id>-ui-needs-you-test-2.md'. All testIDs present (ask-*, job-*, jobs-list, vault-search-*, settings-*, needs-you-*). Installer in fake Termux: first `torus install 3` wrote 16 files; second run reported 'same' 16x and '0 files changed' (idempotent). `torus files` detects differs. `torus backups` + `torus rollback <stamp>` restores modified files. Keep policy on /tmp/fh/.torus/etc/search.conf verified: 'kept yours' without --force, replaced with backup under --force. `printf 'sk-ant-x' | torus key set brave` creates mode-600 file. Deduplication: `pages` SQLite table has 2 rows across many jobs targeting the same URLs, no duplicate URL rows. Settings reset to llm_enabled=false, search_mode=urls at end.

minor.issue: Response exposes fictional default model IDs 'claude-opus-5-5' and 'claude-sonnet-5-5' (via opus_id/sonnet_id/model_id). These do not match any real Anthropic model id and will cause a 404 on the Anthropic API when a real key is configured. User can override via `torus llm id`, but defaults should be real IDs (e.g., claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929, claude-opus-4-5-20250929). Reference: /app/torus/files/bin/gatewayd.py (default llm settings)

action_items: Consider shipping real Anthropic model IDs as defaults instead of 'claude-opus-5-5' / 'claude-sonnet-5-5'. Current defaults will 404 against real Anthropic API; fallback-to-local masks it but users turning the LLM on will always see the warning path.
No other action items. Every feature and bug under test passed. Keep policy, idempotency, rollback, and security headers are all correct.
critical_code_review_comments: gatewayd.py uses a pure stdlib HTTP server to avoid uvicorn on Termux - good trade-off; Host-header check is strict and X-Torus guard works as DNS-rebinding defense.
Job IDs are 1-indexed via source['n'] (not array index). API consumers must read .n from the sources list; this is correct and self-documenting but worth noting in docs.
web/index.html renders job-answer only after the backend writes the dossier; the answer-path testID surfaces the vault path - good for CLI/UI parity.
Installer policy='keep' is correctly honored: files that already exist are preserved without --force and backed up before being replaced with --force.
SQLite `pages` table correctly deduplicates by URL (no duplicate rows across repeated jobs on the same URL).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all tested UI flows (nav, ask-submit, job-status, needs-you paste->done, vault search, settings persist)

Fake Termux install at HOME=/tmp/fh PREFIX=/tmp/fp (used /tmp/tv as venv). Backups stamped under /tmp/fh/.torus/backups/.
